findings: Old Community Communications template site; the homepage is almost entirely images (logo banner, background photo, "welcome" graphic) with the Order Online and Call Us buttons drawn into the banner as clickable image-map hotspots.
Viewport tag uses old, invalid syntax with user-scalable=0, which blocks pinch zoom on phones.
The plain http:// version returns a server error (HTTP 500) instead of redirecting to https.
The menu page is a long plain-text price table; the linked "Download Menu" PDF was last updated in May 2016.
Homepage still promotes an old eDiningExpress phone app (Google Play and iOS badges) next to a separate OrderCounter online ordering page.
questions: The old banner says "We Deliver! Call (603) 755-9001" with tiny text we read as "after 4pm". Is delivery real, from what time, to which towns, and is there a fee or minimum? (We put "Call after 4 PM" on the site and need you to confirm.)
Please confirm hours: closed Monday, 11-9 Tuesday to Saturday, 11-8 Sunday (from the current Hours page). Any holiday or seasonal changes?
The menu says "NEW! 100% made in-house" chicken tenders and sells them by the bucket. What are bucket sizes and prices so we can list them?

Is the Farmington menu on OrderCounter the same price list as the website menu? We used the website prices and the new "Build vs buy" tool depends on them being current (topping prices, medium/large cheese).
The menu page shows 9% NH meals tax; Gilford sites show 8.5%. Please confirm the current rate to display.
Do you want to keep the eDiningExpress app? We left it off; the app badges point to a separate system from OrderCounter.
You have 7 photos of your own food on the old gallery page. Can you send newer ones (storefront, interior, owners, the tenders)? We have no photo of the shop or the people.
No logo file exists except a banner image with the shop name baked in, so we typeset the name. Do you have a clean logo file?
